description: This bar chart illustrates the number of participants who highlighted each evaluation criterion as beneficial. The vertical axis displays the criterion labels: “Relevant FCs”, “FC Summary”, “Relevance Explanation”, “Clarity and Simplicity”, “Overall Summary”, “Filters”, and “Veracity Explanation”, listed in descending order based on the number of participants. The horizontal axis is labeled “Number of Participants” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each criterion is represented by a horizontal bar of a distinct color with its corresponding value labeled at the end; “Relevant FCs” is represented by a purple bar extending to a value of 6, “FC Summary” by a dark blue bar extending to 5, “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” by teal bars extending to 3, “Overall Summary” by a green bar extending to 2, and “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” by light green bars extending to 1. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
